name: Sample: the Bill of Rights
notes:
The Bill of Rights:
1st Amendment: freedom of speech, religion and the press.
2nd Amendment: the right to bear arms.
3rd Amendment: soldiers can't be housed in your home.
4th Amendment: no searches without a warrant.
5th Amendment: you can stay silent instead of testifying against yourself.
6th Amendment: a speedy trial with a lawyer.
7th Amendment: a jury trial in civil lawsuits.
8th Amendment: no cruel or unusual punishment.
9th Amendment: rights not listed still belong to the people.
10th Amendment: powers not given to the federal government belong to the states.

stops.label: foosball table
stops.fact: The 1st Amendment protects freedom of speech, religion and the press.
stops.scene: You see a giant hamburger bun sitting on the foosball table, shouting speeches and holding a glowing press while praying loudly.
stops.imagePrompt: A giant soft hamburger bun is sitting on top of a wooden foosball table. The bun is speaking into a microphone while holding a glowing newspaper and praying. Bright daylight illuminates the playful, cartoonish scene.

stops.label: putting green
stops.fact: The 2nd Amendment grants the right to bear arms.
stops.scene: You see a giant leather shoe bouncing on the putting green, holding a tiny wooden bear and shooting confetti arms into the sky.
stops.imagePrompt: A massive leather shoe stands on a green turf putting green, holding a cute teddy bear and shooting colorful confetti from its sides. The scene is bright and cheerful under clear skies.

stops.label: equipment rental kiosk
stops.fact: The 3rd Amendment prohibits soldiers from being housed in private homes.
stops.scene: You see a leafy green tree crashing through the equipment rental kiosk roof, gently lifting toy soldiers out of tiny paper homes with its branches.
stops.imagePrompt: A leafy green tree bursts through the roof of a small wooden equipment rental kiosk. The tree branches are gently lifting miniature plastic toy soldiers away from tiny cardboard houses. Soft sunlight filters through the leaves.

stops.label: chess set
stops.fact: The 4th Amendment protects against searches without a warrant.
stops.scene: You see a giant wooden door slamming down on the chess set, searching every chess piece with a flashing police warrant.
stops.imagePrompt: A massive wooden door rests sideways across a concrete chess table. A glowing paper warrant is stuck to the surface while toy chess pieces scatter in surprise. Dramatic overhead lighting highlights the cartoon action.

stops.label: wall art
stops.fact: The 5th Amendment allows individuals to remain silent instead of testifying against themselves.
stops.scene: You see a buzzing beehive stuck to the wall art, where a tiny bee zips its lips shut and refuses to testify against the painting.
stops.imagePrompt: A large cartoon beehive is attached to a colorful piece of wall art. A fuzzy bee stands nearby, holding a finger to its zipped mouth in silence. Bright gallery lighting illuminates the playful scene.

stops.label: tv screen
stops.fact: The 6th Amendment guarantees a speedy trial with a lawyer.
stops.scene: You see six sticks forming a frame around the TV screen, where a speedy lawyer runs a race while waving a gavel.
stops.imagePrompt: A flat-screen TV on a wall is surrounded by six wooden sticks. Inside the screen, a cartoon lawyer in a suit sprints across a track while holding a wooden gavel, cinematic lighting.

stops.label: recycling bins
stops.fact: The 7th Amendment guarantees a jury trial in civil lawsuits.
stops.scene: An angel flies out of the recycling bins, holding a tiny jury box and tossing civil lawsuit papers everywhere like confetti.
stops.hook: 7th Amendment → angel; jury trial → jury box; civil lawsuits → civil lawsuit papers
stops.imagePrompt: A glowing cartoon angel hovers above blue recycling bins. The angel holds a miniature wooden jury box in one hand and scatters official legal documents into the air, bright airy lighting.

stops.label: constans theatre door
stops.fact: The 8th Amendment prohibits cruel or unusual punishment.
stops.scene: A massive gate blocks the theatre door, where you watch a cruel-looking mask trying to break through but failing to enter.
stops.hook: 8th Amendment → gate; cruel or unusual punishment → cruel mask
stops.imagePrompt: A heavy iron gate is bolted shut against a theatre door. A whimsical, exaggerated cruel-looking mask with pointy features leans against the gate, vibrant theatre lobby lighting.

stops.label: red armchair
stops.fact: The 9th Amendment states that rights not listed still belong to the people.
stops.scene: You spill a glass of wine onto the red armchair, and suddenly little people made of lights pop out of the fabric to claim the seat.
stops.hook: 9th Amendment → wine; rights → rights/people; people → people
stops.imagePrompt: A glass of red wine spills onto a plush red armchair. From the wet fabric, tiny glowing people figures emerge, sitting on the cushions, cozy warm indoor lighting.

stops.label: reception desk
stops.fact: The 10th Amendment states that powers not given to the federal government belong to the states.
stops.scene: You find a hero eating a massive bun at the reception desk, handing out power badges to the states while ignoring the federal building.
stops.hook: 10th Amendment → bun, hero; federal government → federal building; states → state badges
stops.imagePrompt: A comic-book hero sits at a wooden reception desk eating a large hamburger bun. The hero pins star-shaped badges labeled with state names onto the desk, soft office lighting.
